title: Sharplink hero
description: A dark first screen exactly the window's height: a full-bleed media slot over a black-to-blue sky, a huge two-line headline top left with two stacked square buttons under it, and a bottom row on a 12-column grid: a listing line with an exchange mark, a lead paragraph, and a glass news card. As you scroll away it shrinks to 85%, drifts down and fades out.
notes: always dark: it carries the .dark class, so it uses the theme's dark colours on a light page
media fills the window like object-fit: cover; empty, it shows a black-to-glow gradient placeholder
the exit (scale, drift, fade) is a CSS view timeline; off without support and under reduced motion
